AssessmentMethod.description: The assessment methods Audit applies to an asset.
AssessmentMethod.title: AssessmentMethod

AssessmentStatus.description: How an assessment ended. Only terminal assessments produce a result.
AssessmentStatus.title: AssessmentStatus

result_id.description: The AssessmentResult (contract 3) with the full detail.
result_id.title: Result Id

CcureAssessmentRefV1.description: An Audit assessment (a scan or a compliance run).

completed_at.description: When the assessment reached its terminal state.
completed_at.title: Completed At

scan_policy_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the scan policy snapshot the assessment ran under (GAP-12). Two results with different fingerprints assessed different things and are not directly comparable.
scan_policy_fingerprint.title: Scan Policy Fingerprint

CcureAssessmentRefV1.title: CcureAssessmentRefV1

coverage.description: How completely the asset was assessed. ASSESSED only when every method the scan's policy selected completed.

credentialed.description: The authenticated session. null when no credential was in scope for this asset — which is different from a refused credential.

finding_counts.description: Open findings by severity. null when the asset was NOT_ASSESSED or ERROR: nothing was learned, which is not zero.

CcureAssetRefV1.description:
An asset as Audit knows it.

``asset_id`` is Audit's identifier and is opaque. It is **not** stable
across a change of IP address today (open question Q5), so the identity
attributes are carried beside it for correlation by other modules.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address at assessment time.
ip_address.title: Ip Address

CcureAssetRefV1.title: CcureAssetRefV1

asset_criticality.description: Business criticality 1–10 (SRS 7.3.7.3). Audit has no criticality attribute yet: not_implemented.

audit_host_risk_score.description: Audit's own additive 0–100 host score (core/risk.calculate_risk). It is NOT the SRS weighted risk score.

exposure.description: Network exposure factor (SRS 7.3.7.5). Not computed yet: not_implemented.

network_zone.description: Network segment / Purdue zone (SRS 7.3.1.3). Not modelled yet; always null.
network_zone.title: Network Zone

CcureControlRefV1.description: One control of one framework, e.g. ISO27001_2022 / 2022 / A.8.9.

control_id.description: The control's identifier as the framework publishes it (A.8.9, PR.AA-01, AC-2). Namespace rules are open decision D3.
control_id.title: Control Id

CcureControlRefV1.title: CcureControlRefV1

CcureCredentialedAccessV1.description:
The authenticated session a credentialed assessment ran over.

``outcome`` is the authentication result; coverage is separate
(``inventory_complete`` here and the asset's method results), because a
session that authenticated can still collect only part of what it asked for.

credential_ref.description: Audit's credential identifier. Never the secret.
credential_ref.title: Credential Ref

failure_detail.description: Operator-facing failure text. Never contains the secret.
failure_detail.title: Failure Detail

inventory_complete.description: Whether collection completed. null when not authenticated or not recorded.
inventory_complete.title: Inventory Complete

outcome.description: Authentication result. Audit stores success/failure today; the failure sub-class is available where the transport classified it, otherwise FAILED_UNCLASSIFIED.

transport.description: The transport that was used or attempted.
transport.title: Transport

CcureCredentialedAccessV1.title: CcureCredentialedAccessV1

cve_id.description: The CVE, only when definition_type is cve.
cve_id.title: Cve Id

definition_id.description: Catalogue identifier: a CVE id, or an Audit-minted CCURE-CFG-/CCURE-PRV-/CCURE-CHK- identifier.
definition_id.title: Definition Id

definition_type.description: What kind of entry it is.

CcureEvidenceRefV1.description:
A pointer to evidence Audit holds, retrievable through the evidence
endpoint by a caller with ``audit:evidence:read`` for the same tenant.
Evidence is referenced, not embedded, so a large or sensitive record is
fetched only by a consumer entitled to it.

sha256.description: Digest of the evidence content, where it is a file.
sha256.title: Sha256

CcureEvidenceRefV1.title: CcureEvidenceRefV1

CcureExploitIntelV1.description: Threat intelligence about the vulnerability — not about this host.

in_cisa_kev.description: Listed in CISA KEV. null for non-CVE findings.
in_cisa_kev.title: In Cisa Kev

kev_due_date.description: CISA BOD 22-01 due date, when listed.
kev_due_date.title: Kev Due Date

CcureExploitIntelV1.title: CcureExploitIntelV1

control.description: A control that failed on the asset.

has_more.description: Whether another page is available now.
has_more.title: Has More

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when the consumer is caught up. Cursors are stable: re-reading from a cursor returns the same messages.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

retained_from.description: Oldest message still retained. A cursor older than this answers 410 and the consumer must resynchronise (open question Q6).
retained_from.title: Retained From

finding.description: The finding as it stood at occurred_at. Present for finding.* events.

occurred_at.description: When it happened in Audit (not when it was delivered).
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

previous_state.description: The remediation state before the change, where one changed.
previous_state.title: Previous State

sequence.description: Per-tenant monotonic sequence. Gaps are allowed (events filtered out by subscription); a lower number never follows a higher one.
sequence.title: Sequence

CcureFindingEventV1.description: Pushed to IR; also served by the finding-event feed.

causation_id.description: The message_id of the message that directly caused this one, if any.
causation_id.title: Causation Id

correlation_id.description: Ties together every message and log line caused by one originating request or event. Propagated unchanged from the message that caused this one; a new root starts a new id.
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

message_id.description: Unique per message and stable across retries of the same message. It is the idempotency key: a receiver that has seen it answers with its original result and does nothing else.
message_id.title: Message Id

produced_at.description: When the message was produced. RFC 3339, timezone required.
produced_at.title: Produced At

schema_version.description: The contract's schema version, 1.<minor>. A minor increase only adds optional fields.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

tenant_id.description: The organisation (platform tenant) the message belongs to. Checked against the tenant bound to the caller's service credential.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

CcureFindingEventV1.title: CcureFindingEventV1

CcureFindingRiskV1.description:
SRS 7.3.7.5: ``risk = CVSS×0.4 + Criticality×0.3 + Exposure×0.2 +
Exploit×0.1``. Each component is published separately. Audit can populate
only CVSS and exploit availability today, so the composite, the category and
the residual score are ``not_implemented`` — never computed from zeros.

audit_priority.description: Audit's own KEV/EPSS/exploit priority (core/vuln_intel.compute_priority). Not the SRS score. Computed for display and not stored on the finding, so not published yet; always null.
audit_priority.title: Audit Priority

risk_category.description: SRS 7.3.7.6 tier. Not implemented; always null.
risk_category.title: Risk Category

CcureFindingRiskV1.title: CcureFindingRiskV1

evidence_refs.description: Evidence supporting the finding. null: Audit does not issue evidence references yet — which is not the same as an empty list, which would state that no evidence exists.
evidence_refs.title: Evidence Refs

fixed_at.description: When a scan last found it absent.
fixed_at.title: Fixed At

last_assessment.description: The assessment that last detected it.

status.description: Present on the host or not.

CcureFrameworkRefV1.description: A compliance framework, named by code and version (e.g. ISO27001_2022 / 2022).

code.description: Framework code from the shared framework vocabulary (open decision D3).
code.title: Code

CcureFrameworkRefV1.title: CcureFrameworkRefV1

CcureMeasuredValueV1.description:
A number that may not be available, with the reason when it is not.

This is how a contract says "unknown" without saying "zero". A value is
present exactly when ``status`` is ``available``; any other status carries
no value and must say why.

reason.description: Why no value is present. Required unless status is available.
reason.title: Reason

status.description: Whether a value is present, and if not why.

value.description: The value; present only when status is available.
value.title: Value

CcureMeasuredValueV1.title: CcureMeasuredValueV1

outcome.description: What happened. 'unknown' where Audit recorded no structured outcome — never read it as completed.

CcurePrivilegeContextV1.description:
Which token the authenticated session held. ``null`` means it could not be
read — not "no": a partial audit must not be mistaken for a complete one.

is_administrator.description: Member of the local administrators / root.
is_administrator.title: Is Administrator

CcurePrivilegeContextV1.title: CcurePrivilegeContextV1

guidance.description: Remediation guidance (vendor advisory or check remediation).
guidance.title: Guidance

reopened_count.description: Times the finding returned after a fix.
reopened_count.title: Reopened Count

risk_acceptance.description: Present only while an acceptance is in force.

sla_due_at.description: Due date; null when no SLA applies.
sla_due_at.title: Sla Due At

verified_at.description: When a scan verified the fix (SRS 7.3.5.8).
verified_at.title: Verified At

accepted_by_ref.description: Opaque user reference of the approver.
accepted_by_ref.title: Accepted By Ref

compensating_controls.description: Mandatory in the SRS; not captured on vulnerability findings today — null.
compensating_controls.title: Compensating Controls

expires_at.description: Expiry; null for an indefinite acceptance.
expires_at.title: Expires At

CcureSourceV1.description: Which module, and which build of it, produced a message.

instance.description: The deployment instance, where a module runs more than one.
instance.title: Instance

module_version.description: The producing module's release, for diagnosing a bad message.
module_version.title: Module Version

CcureSourceV1.title: CcureSourceV1

CoverageState.description: How completely one asset was assessed.
CoverageState.title: CoverageState

CredentialOutcome.description:
The result of the authenticated session a credentialed assessment needs.

The four failure members are distinct because each sends the operator to a
different fix: a wrong password, an account without rights, a host that
did not answer, and anything else. ``FAILED_UNCLASSIFIED`` is used where
the transport could not tell which.
CredentialOutcome.title: CredentialOutcome

DefinitionType.description: What kind of catalogue entry a finding is an instance of.
DefinitionType.title: DefinitionType

DetectionMethod.description: How Audit concluded that a finding applies to the host.
DetectionMethod.title: DetectionMethod

DetectionStatus.description: Whether the finding is present on the host (a detection question).
DetectionStatus.title: DetectionStatus

ExploitAvailability.description:
Threat-intelligence exploit evidence for a vulnerability (SRS 7.3.7.4).

This describes the vulnerability, not the host: a public exploit existing
does not mean this host is exploitable.
ExploitAvailability.title: ExploitAvailability

MethodOutcome.description:
What happened to one method on one asset.

``unknown`` exists because Audit does not yet record a structured outcome
for every method on every path. It is the honest answer where the record
is missing, and it must never be read as ``completed``.
MethodOutcome.title: MethodOutcome

Module.description: The four CCure modules, plus the shared platform.
Module.title: Module

RemediationState.description:
Where the work to fix a finding stands. ``verified_fixed`` is reached only
by a scan, never by a person and never by another module.
RemediationState.title: RemediationState

Severity.description:
Technical severity. ``unscored`` (no rating published) is a different fact
from ``none`` (a published rating of zero).
Severity.title: Severity

SlaState.description:
``not_applicable`` — the finding carries no deadline. It is deliberately not
``within_sla``: "inside its deadline" and "has no deadline" are different.
SlaState.title: SlaState

ValueStatus.description: Why a measured value is or is not present.
ValueStatus.title: ValueStatus
